title: Multiversal External Game Projection Contract
objective: A future owner Continue must governed-start a bounded provider-neutral external-game projection contract for Character, Creature, Item, Action, Condition, Encounter, Scene, Vehicle and Rule-reference projections before any VTI-02 acceptance package or production implementation begins.
selection_boundaries: VTI-01 remains completed_verified and frozen with its implementation authority retired.
Multiversal remains the canonical rules and campaign authority; external VTTs consume projections and never become replacement rules authorities.

VTI-02 selection authorizes no implementation branch, acceptance package, adapter implementation, credential use, external account mutation, synchronization, package distribution or canonical game-state mutation.
The projection contract must be provider-neutral and must not select or rank a vendor; evidence-driven platform selection remains deferred to VTI-09.
Visibility, ownership, consent, hidden-information filtering and GM authority must remain explicit projection constraints.
Unsupported or unavailable target fidelity must remain explicit rather than being manufactured or inferred.
VTI-03+, SGC-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
next_action: A future owner Continue performs one bounded VTI-02 governed-start pass from exact application main 027fad06d0bac3a20d56f0cc2a674581662cd1b9 before creating a VTI-02 branch, acceptance package or production change.
